method: Each session is reported separately. Ratios are candidate / previous per-case medians. Each suite uses exactly the old/new Q-Rust cases eligible in both sessions, requiring all warmups and trials to pass. Ratios >1 are retained as observed slowdowns without an added significance claim. Compiler time and complete request wall time are separate metrics. All cell metric summaries are retained; no pooled session samples or selective successful trials. The sum-of-medians calculation describes one occurrence of each eligible case; it is not a measured batch wall time and does not include startup, scheduling or inter-request overhead. It weights cases by absolute duration, unlike a geometric mean of relative per-case changes.
